pets.description: A quiet chibi digital pet inspired by a pale long-haired composer in an oversized navy jacket.
pets.descriptionZh: 一只安静的 Q 版桌宠，灵感来自浅色长发、穿着宽大深蓝外套的作曲少女。

pets.description: A cute chibi vampire pet inspired by Remilia Scarlet, with red eyes, pale blue-purple hair, pink frills, red bows, and tiny bat wings.
pets.descriptionZh: 一只可爱的 Q 版吸血鬼桌宠，灵感来自蕾米莉亚的红眼、浅蓝紫短发、粉色荷叶边、红色蝴蝶结和小蝙蝠翼。
